title: The Parish of the Marlowe Estate
author: Emrys Almeida
blurb: Elodie Whitlock, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
